name: Rooftop at night
desc: The private ledge above a loud city - where two people go to talk, or one goes to be alone.
tags: flat rooftop, gravel roof surface, chain link fence, roof parapet, air conditioning units, rooftop water tank, ventilation ducts, skyline of lit windows, aircraft warning light, distant city glow
prose: the flat gravel roof of a city building at night, ringed by a chain-link fence and cluttered with air-conditioning units, ventilation ducts and a water tank, a skyline of lit windows standing below the parapet
note: The default rooftop is an empty grey rectangle with a skyline pasted behind it. The roof furniture - vents, water tank, ducts, fence - is what makes it a place and gives a figure something to stand beside. Name the parapet whenever anyone goes near the edge, otherwise the roof runs off to nothing and the drop is invisible, which is usually the whole reason for the scene.
